name: village-store-coins-wild-only-v1
description: ⭐ THE n-OF-SUIT QUESTION, AND IT IS A ONE-LEAF ARM. This is the assembled Village Store coin with rules.economy.coinPaysSuitCost turned OFF: a coin still pays a build cost's WILD slots (rules.economy.coinPaysBuild true) but never its SUIT requirement, so a card costing '2 apples and a wild' can take one coin and not three. Everything else matches the assembled arm: rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard 1, rules.economy.coinSupplyPerPlayer 5, rules.economy.coinPaysGrow true and rules.economy.coinGrowOnFullBuilding true. ⛔ ITS CONTROL AND ITS PAIRED ARM IS overlays/village-store-coins-v1.overlay.json AND THE TWO DIFFER IN EXACTLY ONE LEAF, which is what makes the reading clean. Its second control, further back, is overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json, whose twenty leaves are all pinned here by name. ⛔ WHY IT EXISTS: 'COINS PAY WILD COSTS ONLY' AND 'COINS PAY EVERYTHING' ARE MEANINGFULLY DIFFERENT GAMES AND IT IS ONE RUN TO FIND OUT. Dean split the leaf on purpose on 12/09/2026 (V6, ledger A150) rather than shipping the stronger reading unexamined. ⭐ AND THE READING IT OWNS IS OWN-CROP BUILD SHARE, against its standing 83% (82.6% before v31, 83.3% after). A wild that pays a suit requirement is the FIRST THING ANYBODY HAS PROPOSED that makes off-crop building and off-suit Powers cheap, so it pushes directly against the monoculture pull that the Innovation lens flags as this design's structural fault: the metric axis must not be the specialisation axis, and the Farmstead plus own-suit Power costs push on it from two directions already. IF THE ASSEMBLED ARM MOVES THE SHARE AND THIS ONE DOES NOT, THE SUIT-COST HALF IS WHAT DID IT. Read buildings built by crop beside it, and the win rate gap of Orchard 17.4% against Wheat 41.9%. ⚠️ AND THE COST OF TURNING IT OFF IS ALSO WORTH READING: Power and Endgame cards cost two cards of their OWN suit (V7), so with this leaf off, two coins no longer buys one. That is a real reduction in what a coin is worth and it may show up as a lower conversion rate rather than as a build-mix change. ⛔ C100 IS STILL OPEN AND NO NOTICE BOARD ARM IS RULED IN AS THE SHIPPED GAME: the shipped default is rules.turn.visitCurrency 'commons', so THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM, and here it is an arm on an arm on an arm, since its own pairing is against another unruled coin arm. Every report header quoting it must say so. The seat-shaped host draw is only the best-performing configuration measured (5 PASS / 1 FAIL / 11 OBSERVE), not a ruling. ⭐ THE BUILDER DEFAULTS THIS ARM CARRIES, NAMED RATHER THAN DISCOVERED, because on 05/09/2026 an arm built for one purpose carried three unnamed knob changes and ruling it in ruled all four. Dean confirmed the indicated reading on all of D1 to D9 on 12/09/2026 and ruled D7 explicitly. D1: cards paid into the exchange go to the SUIT'S DISCARD and never out of the game, which is Dean's circulation argument. D2: ANY delivery mints, including one bought by a Notice Board power. D3: declining to mint is EXPLICIT, so the turn settles cleanly. D4: an empty supply mid-conversion STOPS rather than refusing the whole exchange. D5: a coin-Grow DOES fire 'when activated' abilities, since the Grow sink is on in this arm. D6: a coin does NOT count as a card for any card text that counts cards paid, the same family as the O17 fix. ⚠️ D7, D8 and D9 have no subject here because there is no meeple. ⛔ WHAT MAY NOT BE QUOTED OFF THIS ARM. (1) THE BONUS RATE IS A SHARE OF TURNS AND NEVER PLAYS PER TURN; judging the band on plays cost this project a re-run of five arms on 09/09/2026. (2) NO LEVEL HERE IS COMPARABLE WITH A reference-v14 OR EARLIER NUMBER; only a delta paired on identical seeds against a named control is sound. (3) THE BARN GLUT READS +0.5 IDENTICALLY ACROSS THIS WHOLE FAMILY ON BYTE-IDENTICAL PER-SEAT LINES, so read the per-seat rows and NEVER the pooled median. (4) The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none. (5) ⛔ THIS ARM IS NOT A TEST OF THE BUILD SINK. Isolating Build from Grow is overlays/village-store-coins-build-only-v1.overlay.json; this file changes the SHAPE of the Build sink, not its presence. ⛔ C113 STILL APPLIES, THE ARM'S OWN TEST FROM THE OTHER SIDE. docs/village-store-2026-08-19-v1.md section 1 tested this exact rider-on-Deliver placement and ruled it out: 'Free / a rider on Deliver. No cost, so it is always correct. Breaks everything.' Dean's answer of 12/09/2026 is that a valid delivery is a precondition and the capped supply bounds the reward. THE CORE OBJECTION STANDS AS A TEST: if every player converts every spare card every time, the August verdict was right and THE PLACEMENT IS WHAT TO CHANGE. ⭐ THIS ARM IS THE ONE PLACE WHERE A PRICE READING IS AVAILABLE ON THAT QUESTION, because it is the only file in the family that makes a coin worth LESS without making it rarer: if conversion stays universal here too, the placement and not the coin's power is the fault. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME. THIRTY LEAVES. The control's twenty, unchanged and in its own order: rules.turn.visitCurrency, bonusTiming, selfVisitAllowed, hostDrawOnVisit, commonsTake, startingMeeplesPerColour, meepleAsCard, slotToll, meepleCapPerColour; rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold, noticeBoardBlocks, unclaimedBoardsToCentre, noticeBoardsBySeats.2, .3 and .4, commonsColourMatch, commonsWildPair, endgameCoinCost, farmsteadCoinPower; and rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4. ⛔ TWO OF THOSE ARE COIN LEAVES AND THEY STAY OFF ON PURPOSE: rules.economy.endgameCoinCost null and rules.economy.farmsteadCoinPower false belong to the separate commons-with-coins arm of 10/09/2026 and are a second mint and a second sink; keeping them off is what makes rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard the only faucet. Then the six coin leaves, five on and coinPaysSuitCost off, and the four meeple leaves pinned at their shipped values so the delivery meeple cannot ride in: rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace null (which means defer to the existing meeplesPerTile seeding and NOT 'no meeples'), meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null (unlimited) and meepleSpendDistinctColours false. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against overlays/village-store-coins-v1.overlay.json on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. ⚠️ AS OF COMMIT e5aea08 ALL TEN NEW LEAVES ARE INERT: they exist in the data layer and no branch of play reads them yet, so this arm currently measures identically to both of its controls. A run before the engine slices land proves the file parses and validates, and nothing else. ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ APIARY PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the Apiary board's retext in as the shipped default (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild', "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", the deck card paying any activation cost). This overlay predates it, so apiaryPower is pinned here BY NAME at 'sow' (the S12 Sow 2) and it still replays its own game. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay sets its own meeple leaves and keeps them, and pins the two new leaves BY NAME at their off values (deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0), so it still replays its own game.
